wikitext: [[File:Bubble Beam Berry Blast.png|thumb|350px|Bubble Beam Berry Blast]] '''Bubble Beam Berry Blast''' (Japanese: ''{{j|Bubble Beam Berry Blast}}'') is a 1-minute {{pkmn|animation|animated}} short to celebrate {{type|Water}} Pokémon throughout the month of June 2024.[https://www.pokemon.com/us/pokemon-news/dive-into-a-celebration-of-water-type-pokemon Dive into a Celebration of Water-Type Pokémon] - [[Pokémon.com]] It was uploaded to the official American and European [[YouTube]] channels on June 4, 2024, on the Japanese channel on June 6, 2024, on the Asian channels on Jun 7, 2024. The short was accompanied by an annoucement of [[mass outbreak]]s in {{g|Scarlet and Violet}} featuring Water-type Pokémon such as {{p|Horsea}}, {{p|Lotad}}, and {{p|Finizen}} from June 6 to June 9, 2024,[https://www.pokemon.com/us/pokemon-news/catch-water-type-pokemon-in-pokemon-scarlet-and-pokemon-violet-mass-outbreaks Catch Water-Type Pokémon in Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet Mass Outbreaks] - [[Pokémon.com]] in addition to 7-star [[Tera Raid Battle]]s featuring {{p|Swampert}} announced earlier.[https://www.pokemon.com/us/pokemon-news/swampert-with-the-mightiest-mark-is-coming-to-7-star-tera-raid-battles Swampert with the Mightiest Mark Is Coming to 7-Star Tera Raid Battles] - [[Pokémon.com]] ==Blurb== Join our aquatic party of Palafin, Greninja, Quaxly, and Piplup as they lend each other a Helping Hand in their pursuit of berries! ==Plot== {{p|Palafin}}, {{p|Greninja}}, {{p|Quaxly}}, and {{p|Piplup}} are hanging out near a pond. Palafin points to a [[Sitrus Berry]] on a nearby tree and {{m|Jet Punch|launches its gloves}} to knock the [[berry]] off the tree. While Palafin shows off, Greninja uses its {{m|Water Shuriken}} to knock off the berries, and moves at a fast speed to catch it, messing up Quaxly's hair in the process. After Quaxly fixes its hair, it uses {{m|Water Gun}} to knock off a [[Tamato Berry]] from a neighbouring tree. Next, Piplup jumps up on a rock for its turn and uses {{m|Bubble Beam}} at a [[Qualot Berry]], but the weak attack fails to knock the berry off the tree. Piplup tries and fails again and falls off the rock. Dejected, it starts walking away. The other Pokémon cheer it using {{m|Helping Hand}} and Piplup aims a powerful Bubble Beam at the berry. However the attack is so powerful that it blows away all the tree leaves, leaving only the trunk behind. As berries start raining down around them, Greninja, Quaxly and Pipulp run away, while a Sitrus Berry falls on Palafin's head. ==Characters== ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Palafin}} ({{fd|Palafin|Hero Form}}) * {{p|Greninja}} * {{p|Quaxly}} * {{p|Piplup}} ==Video== {{YouTubeEmbed|l_vUTm1yXR8|Pokemon|name=The Official Pokémon YouTube channel|Water}} ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{Water color}}|bordercolor={{Water color dark}} |en=Bubble Beam Berry Blast 🌊 🌊 |ja={{j|Bubble Beam Berry Blast}} |fr=concours de tir sur Baie 🫧 🌊 |de=Blubbstrahl-Beerendusche 🫧 🌊 |it=abbatti le bacche 🫧 🌊 |es_eu=¡Baya batalla! 🫧 🌊 |es_la=¡Baya batalla! 🫧 🌊 |pt_br=Pegando Frutas de montão com Jato de Bolhas Pokémon! |zh_cmn=泡沫光線樹果收穫戰 |id=Bubble Beam Berry Blast |th=Bubble Beam Berry Blast }} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== * Video ** English ([https://youtu.be/l_vUTm1yXR8 International], [https://youtu.be/8OQR36cclhU Asia]) ** [https://youtu.be/k1vdQvb44pA Japanese] ** [https://youtu.be/GMjywNNLDUw Mandarin Chinese (Taiwan)] ** [https://youtu.be/pRl2zREiaPc French] ** [https://youtu.be/Bu1DqXqN54U German] ** [https://youtu.be/ttOPmRuiSdw Indonesian] ** [https://youtu.be/Iz9PmGjGmaw Italian] ** [https://youtu.be/yMgF2zIiFtU Portuguese (Brasil)] ** Spanish ([https://youtu.be/qdgUpl0z-fQ Europe], [https://youtu.be/LDtEjYrvgrg Latin America]) ** [https://youtu.be/DWkGqees9pE Thai] {{Project Anime notice}} [[Category:Animation]] [[zh:水属性宝可梦庆典]]
